## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] RU and EN are complete for all visible copy.
- [ ] Dark, light, keyboard, and reduced-motion behavior were considered.
- [ ] Privileged validation and writes remain in Rust.
- [ ] Preview behavior is labelled and no unsupported safety claim was added.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed success and failure paths.
- [ ] New assets and dependencies have recorded provenance.
- [ ] No secrets, user data, generated installers, or local paths are included.
